shortDescription: This module manages syslog server on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: audit
options.description: Specifies whether the server receives CLI audit logs. The default value is off.

options.name: cadf
options.description: Specifies that Cloud Auditing Data Federation (CADF) data reporting be turned on or off. The parameters I(facility) and I (cadf) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: error
options.description: Specifies whether the server receives error notifications. If specified as on, error notifications are sent to the syslog server. The default value is on.

options.name: facility
options.description: Specifies the facility number used in syslog messages. This number identifies the origin of the message to the receiving server. The default value is 0. The parameters I(facility) and I (cadf) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: info
options.description: Specifies whether the server receives information notifications. If specified as on, information notifications are sent to the syslog server. The default value is on.

options.name: ip
options.description: Specifies the Internet Protocol (IP) address or domain name of the syslog server. If a domain name is specified, a DNS server must be configured on the system.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: login
options.description: Specifies whether the server receives authentication logs. The default value is off.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of a syslog server.

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name of a syslog server to rename. Valid when I(state=present), to rename the existing syslog server.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the communication port that is used by this server. The parameter I(protocol) must be specified while specifying this parameter. The default value is 514 for udp and 6514 for tcp.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Specifies the communication protocol that is used by this server. The default value is udp.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates, updates (C(present)) or deletes (C(absent)) a syslog server.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.

options.name: warning
options.description: Specifies whether the server receives warning notifications. If specified as on, warning notifications are sent to the syslog server. The default value is on.
